```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
```

```{r}
tg <- st_read("../DATA-510/time_grid/time_grid.shp")
tgdf <- read_csv("data/processed_grid/time_grid.csv")
```

```{r}
names(tgdf)
```

Primary question: differences between wildfires in grid cells that have had previous RX burns vs those that have not.

```{r}
tgdf %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(rx_csum = cumsum(n_rx)) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = rx_csum > 0,
        has_plant = plnt_sm > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(has_plant, had_rx, year) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_acres = mean(max_acres, na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_dur = mean(max_duration, na.rm=TRUE),
        n = n()
    ) %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    print(n=Inf)

tgdf %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(
        rx_csum = cumsum(n_rx),
        rx_rollsum = rollapply(n_rx, 2, sum, partial=TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = rx_rollsum > 0,
        rx_lim = ifelse(rx_rollsum > 2, 3, rx_rollsum),
        has_plant = plnt_sm > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(has_plant, rx_lim, year) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_acres = mean(max_acres, na.rm=TRUE),
        mean_dur = mean(max_duration, na.rm=TRUE),
        n = n()
    ) %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    print(n=Inf)

```


```{r}
tgdf %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(rx_csum = cumsum(n_rx)) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = rx_csum > 0,
        has_plant = plnt_sm > 0
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=year, y=max_acres, color=had_rx)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~had_rx)

# i think there's something here but it's hard to evaluate
tgdf %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(rx_csum = cumsum(n_rx)) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = rx_csum > 0,
        has_plant = plnt_sm > 0
    ) %>%
    filter(year>2020) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=log(max_acres), fill=had_rx)) +
    geom_density() +
    facet_grid(year~had_rx)

```


```{r}
tgdf %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(rx_csum = cumsum(n_rx)) %>%
    mutate(
        had_rx = rx_csum > 0,
        has_plant = plnt_sm > 0
    ) %>%
    filter(year>2020) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=max_acres, fill=had_rx)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_grid(year~had_rx) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log(digits=2)) +
    theme_bw()

```


```{r}
tgdf %>%
    filter(year >= 2020) %>%
    group_by(n_fires) %>%
    summarize(
        max = max(max_acres),
        avg = mean(max_acres),
        n=n()
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_fires))
```
